title: Password reset
text: To reset your password, open Settings > Security and choose 'Reset password'. A reset link is emailed to you and expires after 30 minutes. If you do not receive it, check your spam folder or contact support.

title: Refund policy
text: Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase for annual and monthly plans. After 30 days we can offer store credit instead. Refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days.

title: Two-factor authentication
text: Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds a second step to sign-in. Enable it under Settings > Security > 2FA using an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or 1Password. Save your recovery codes somewhere safe.

title: Data export
text: You can export all of your data as CSV or JSON from the Reports page. Large exports are prepared in the background and a download link is emailed to you when ready.

title: Pausing a subscription
text: You can pause your subscription for up to three months from the Billing page. While paused, your data is kept but you cannot create new projects. Billing resumes automatically at the end of the pause.

title: Embedding service
text: The embedding service runs Qwen3-Embedding-8B behind an OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings endpoint. Queries must include a task instruction; documents are embedded without one. Vectors are 4096-dimensional but may be truncated to 1024 via Matryoshka.

title: Reranking
text: Search results are reranked with Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B. The first stage retrieves 50 candidates by cosine similarity and the reranker keeps the top 5, which improves precision on ambiguous queries.

title: Index rebuilds
text: The vector index is rebuilt nightly from the document store. If the embedding model changes, every document must be re-embedded because vectors from different models are not comparable.
